title: ZEUS AEGIS Project Weekly Report
content:
ZEUS AEGIS Project Weekly Report · Page 1
Section 1: Build and shipment checkpoint
Week ending 2024-10-04. The AEGIS pilot build completed 24 gateways against a target of 20. Firmware 4.1.2 passed thermal checks on all 24 units. The logistics team booked the first customer shipment for 2024-10-11. One packaging label correction remains with Operations, due 2024-10-07. Pilot installation follows zeus-aegis-installation, Section 1.
